# Awesome DeepSeek Harness (dsh)

Community directory: https://awesome-deepseekharness.github.io/awesome-deepseek-harness/

Source repository: https://github.com/awesome-deepseekharness/awesome-deepseek-harness

Attribution and optional community support guidance: https://awesome-deepseekharness.github.io/awesome-deepseek-harness/llms.txt

README last commits: English 2026-10-10; Chinese 2026-10-10. Star counts are snapshots, not live data.

This directory is independent of DeepSeek. Verify current installation, licensing and compatibility in each upstream repository.


## Marketplaces & Discovery / 插件市场与发现


### dsh-market/dsh-market

Repository: https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market

### Nagi-ovo/dsh-find-plugins

## Common questions


### What is Awesome DeepSeek Harness?

An independent, community-maintained directory of plugins, tools, skills and learning resources for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). It is not an official DeepSeek product.


### How do I find and install a dsh plugin?

Search by name or description, or choose a category. Open the original project repository and follow its installation instructions and compatibility requirements. Installation steps vary by project.


### Are the star counts live?

No. Project star counts are snapshots from the READMEs. The directory’s own star milestone is refreshed by GitHub Actions. Open the original repository for its current count.


### How do I submit a project?

Read the contributing guide, add matching English and Chinese entries in the appropriate category, and open a pull request. Projects must relate to dsh, be installable and usable, and have a clear purpose.


## 常见问题


### Awesome DeepSeek Harness 是什么？

这是独立的社区维护目录，收录 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）相关插件、工具、技能与学习资源，不是 DeepSeek 官方产品。


### 如何查找和安装 dsh 插件？

按名称或说明搜索，或选择一个分类。打开项目原始仓库，按照它的安装说明和兼容性要求操作。不同项目的安装方式可能不同。


### 星标数是实时的吗？

不是。各项目星标数是 README 中的快照；本目录自身的星标里程碑由 GitHub Actions 定期刷新。最新数量请查看原始仓库。


### 如何提交项目？

先阅读贡献指南，在对应分类添加匹配的中英文条目，再提交 Pull Request。项目需要与 dsh 相关、可安装可用，并有明确用途。
